text:
lucy-partnerships: FYI OpenForge sent a proposed redistribution addendum for their 11B model. They want marketplace listings (AWS/GCP) + option to bundle with our edge appliance. They also asked for a coordinated embargoed announcement. Can legal/ops/hw/product flag any blockers?
matt-legal: Quick read: their draft includes a non-commercial clause and a viral copyleft addendum. Both are problematic for commercial marketplace listings and HW bundles. We need an explicit commercial redistribution grant and a carve-out that prevents share-alike from infecting our appliance images.
sujay-ops: Ops needs: signed_manifest.json, SHA256 of artifact, OpenPGP fingerprint for weights, provenance fields, and an S3 staging path with KMS policy if encrypted. Also require a checkbox for allowed_regions in manifest for geo-blocking.
fae-product: Marketplace schema needs SKU, 160-char short description, tags (quantized/int8/11B/llama-family), latency bucket, pricing matrix, owner contact, and README URL. For bundles we should create distinct SKUs.
kevin-hw: For appliance bundles we need firmware compatibility statement and a short export/firmware restriction line. Hardware validation is ~4-6 business days. Prefer separate SKU for "appliance bundle" so warranty and support mapping is clear.
lucy-partnerships: Can we accept CC-BY-SA if provider insists?
matt-legal: CC-BY-SA is acceptable only with a written exception in the addendum that exempts our distribution artifacts (images, firmware) from share-alike obligations. Otherwise it would force redistribution of our packaging. We'll draft a short carve-out clause.
sujay-ops: Tech note: we should require a signed attestation of training data provenance (high-level) to include in vendor docs. Also will run malware scan and pre-quant test on staging. Who will get the initial manifest from the provider?
lucy-partnerships: I'll request the manifest and ask them to PGP-sign the weights today. Timeline: provider requests announcement week of Jun 7, embargo Jun 8 09:00 PT. Realistic?
fae-product: If we get signed addendum + artifacts by May 20, product+ops can list and QA by Jun 3. Legal needs 3 business days after final addendum. HW validation must start by May 25 to make bundle on Jun 8. Tight but feasible.
matt-legal: I'll prepare addendum v2 with an Exhibit A template (geo/export) and a share-alike carve-out; need provider to accept by May 18.
kevin-hw: I'll block validation calendar May 25-31.
sujay-ops: I'll make the ops ticket and entitlement flow; will require allowed_regions field and entitlement token for bundle provisioning.
lucy-partnerships: Action items: 1) Lucy to request manifest + fingerprint today (due May 5) 2) Matt to draft addendum v2 with carve-out (due May 15) 3) Sujay to prepare ops checklist & entitlement flow (due May 18) 4) Fae to draft SKU/readme templates and marketplace copy (due May 20) 5) Kevin to schedule hardware validation (start May 25)
matt-legal: Draft attribution for listing OK to use: "Model by OpenForge; inference served by Redwood Inference."
announce-bot: Reminder: announcement artifact will be generated after signatures and validation pass.
lucy-partnerships: Thanks all — I'll update once I have the signed_manifest and provider confirmation.
